crm.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_email" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "message_subject" text NULL, "message_body" text NULL, "timezone" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "scheduled_date_time" datetime NULL, "scheduled_later" bool NOT NULL, "from_email" varchar(254) NOT NULL, "rendered_message_body" text NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "from_account_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_email_recipients" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "accountemail_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "contact_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "email" varchar(254) NULL, "phone" varchar(25) NULL, "website" varchar(200) NULL, "industry" varchar(255) NULL, "number_of_employees" integer unsigned NULL CHECK ("number_of_employees" >= 0), "annual_revenue" decimal NULL, "address_line" varchar(255) NULL, "city" varchar(255) NULL, "state" varchar(255) NULL, "postcode" varchar(64) NULL, "country" varchar(3) NULL, "description" text NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "currency" varchar(3) NULL, "custom_fields" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("custom_fields") OR "custom_fields" IS NULL)), "is_sample" bool NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "account_revenue_non_negative" CHECK (("annual_revenue" >= '0' OR "annual_revenue" IS NULL)) );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts_assigned_to" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "account_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "profile_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts_contacts" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "account_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "contact_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts_tags" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "account_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "tags_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts_teams" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "account_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "teams_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "entity_type" varchar(50) NOT NULL, "entity_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "entity_name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "user_id" char(32) NULL, "metadata" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("metadata") OR "metadata" IS NULL)), "action" varchar(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "address" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "address_line" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "street" varchar(55) NOT NULL, "city" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "state" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "postcode" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "country" varchar(3) NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "apiSettings" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title" text NOT NULL, "website" varchar(255) NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "apikey" varchar(64) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "apiSettings_lead_assigned_to" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "apisettings_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "profile_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "apiSettings_tags" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "apisettings_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "tags_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "approval" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "state" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "note" text NOT NULL, "reason" text NOT NULL, "decided_at" datetime NULL, "approver_id" char(32) NULL, "case_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "requested_by_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "rule_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "approval_rule" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(128) NOT NULL, "trigger_event" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "match_priority" varchar(32) NULL, "match_case_type" varchar(32) NULL, "approver_role" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "match_team_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "approval_rule_approvers" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "approvalrule_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "profile_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "object_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "file_name" varchar(60) NOT NULL, "attachment" varchar(1001) NOT NULL, "content_type_id" integer NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "auth_group" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "auth_group_permissions" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "group_id" integer NOT NULL, "permission_id" integer NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "auth_permission" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "content_type_id" integer NOT NULL, "codename" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "automation_rotation" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "action_index" smallint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("action_index" >= 0), "next_index" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("next_index" >= 0), "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "rule_id" char(32) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "uniq_automation_rotation" UNIQUE ("rule_id", "action_index") );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "automation_rule" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(120) NOT NULL, "object_key" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "trigger" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("trigger") OR "trigger" IS NULL)), "match" varchar(3) NOT NULL, "conditions" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("conditions") OR "conditions" IS NULL)), "actions" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("actions") OR "actions" IS NULL)), "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "position" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("position" >= 0), "switched_on_at" datetime NULL, "paused_reason" varchar(32) NOT NULL, "last_failure_notice_at" datetime NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "owner_id" char(32) NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "automation_run" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "object_key" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "record_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "record_name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "status" varchar(8) NOT NULL, "reason" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "chain_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "depth" smallint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("depth" >= 0), "steps" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("steps") OR "steps" IS NULL)), "skipped_count" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("skipped_count" >= 0), "window_start" datetime NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "rule_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "triggered_by_id" char(32) NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "board" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "description" text NULL, "is_archived" bool NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "owner_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "board_column" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "order" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("order" >= 0), "color" varchar(7) NOT NULL, "limit" integer unsigned NULL CHECK ("limit" >= 0), "board_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "board_member" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "role" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "board_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "profile_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "board_task" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "description" text NULL, "order" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("order" >= 0), "priority" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "due_date" datetime NULL, "completed_at" datetime NULL, "account_id" char(32) NULL, "column_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "contact_id" char(32) NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "opportunity_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "board_task_assigned_to" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "boardtask_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "profile_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_calendar" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "timezone" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "is_default" bool NOT NULL, "monday_open" time NULL, "monday_close" time NULL, "tuesday_open" time NULL, "tuesday_close" time NULL, "wednesday_open" time NULL, "wednesday_close" time NULL, "thursday_open" time NULL, "thursday_close" time NULL, "friday_open" time NULL, "friday_close" time NULL, "saturday_open" time NULL, "saturday_close" time NULL, "sunday_open" time NULL, "sunday_close" time NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_holiday" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "date" date NOT NULL, "name" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "calendar_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, CONSTRAINT "uniq_business_holiday_per_calendar_date" UNIQUE ("calendar_id", "date") );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_feed_token" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "token_hash" varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "last_used_at" datetime NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "profile_id" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "status" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "priority" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "case_type" varchar(255) NULL, "closed_on" date NULL, "description" text NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "account_id" char(32) NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "first_response_at" datetime NULL, "resolved_at" datetime NULL, "sla_first_response_hours" integer unsigned NULL CHECK ("sla_first_response_hours" >= 0), "kanban_order" decimal NOT NULL, "stage_id" char(32) NULL, "custom_fields" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("custom_fields") OR "custom_fields" IS NULL)), "escalation_count" smallint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("escalation_count" >= 0), "last_escalation_fired_at" datetime NULL, "external_thread_id" varchar(255) NULL, "alt_thread_ids" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("alt_thread_ids") OR "alt_thread_ids" IS NULL)), "merged_at" datetime NULL, "merged_by_id" char(32) NULL, "sla_paused_at" datetime NULL, "sla_paused_seconds" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("sla_paused_seconds" >= 0), "is_problem" bool NOT NULL, "merge_record" text NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("merge_record") OR "merge_record" IS NULL)), "is_sample" bool NOT NULL, "sla_resolution_hours" integer unsigned NULL CHECK ("sla_resolution_hours" >= 0), "merged_into_id" char(32) NULL, "parent_id" char(32) NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_assigned_to" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "case_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "profile_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_contacts" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "case_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "contact_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_pipeline" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "description" text NULL, "is_default" bool NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_stage" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "order" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("order" >= 0), "color" varchar(7) NOT NULL, "stage_type" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "maps_to_status" varchar(64) NULL, "wip_limit" integer unsigned NULL CHECK ("wip_limit" >= 0), "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "pipeline_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_tags" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "case_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "tags_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_teams" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "case_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "teams_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_watcher" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "subscribed_via" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "case_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "profile_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, CONSTRAINT "uniq_case_watcher_per_profile" UNIQUE ("case_id", "profile_id") );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "comment" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "object_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "commented_on" datetime NOT NULL, "content_type_id" integer NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "commented_by_id" char(32) NULL, "is_internal" bool NOT NULL, "commented_by_contact_id" char(32) NULL, "comment" text NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "comment_single_author" CHECK (("commented_by_id" IS NULL OR "commented_by_contact_id" IS NULL)) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commentFiles" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "comment_file" varchar(100) NULL, "comment_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contact_form_submission" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "email" varchar(254) NOT NULL, "message" text NOT NULL, "reason" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "ip_address" char(39) NULL, "user_agent" text NULL, "referrer" varchar(500) NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "replied_at" datetime NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "replied_by_id" char(32) NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contacts" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "first_name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "last_name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "email" varchar(254) NULL, "phone" varchar(25) NULL, "organization" varchar(255) NULL, "title" varchar(255) NULL, "department" varchar(255) NULL, "do_not_call" bool NOT NULL, "address_line" varchar(255) NULL, "city" varchar(255) NULL, "state" varchar(255) NULL, "postcode" varchar(64) NULL, "country" varchar(3) NULL, "description" text NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "account_id" char(32) NULL, "linkedin_url" varchar(200) NULL, "auto_created" bool NOT NULL, "custom_fields" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("custom_fields") OR "custom_fields" IS NULL)), "is_sample" bool NOT NULL, "phone_e164" varchar(32) NOT NULL, "source" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "source_detail" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "source_ref" varchar(255) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contacts_assigned_to" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "contact_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "profile_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contacts_tags" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "contact_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "tags_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contacts_teams" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "contact_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "teams_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "csat_survey" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "token_hash" varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "sent_at" datetime NOT NULL, "rating" smallint unsigned NULL CHECK ("rating" >= 0), "comment" text NOT NULL, "responded_at" datetime NULL, "expires_at" datetime NOT NULL, "case_id" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "contact_id" char(32) NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_field_definition" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "target_model" varchar(32) NOT NULL, "key" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "label" varchar(128) NOT NULL, "field_type" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "options" text NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("options") OR "options" IS NULL)), "is_required" bool NOT NULL, "is_filterable" bool NOT NULL, "display_order" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("display_order" >= 0), "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, CONSTRAINT "uniq_custom_field_per_org_target" UNIQUE ("org_id", "target_model", "key") );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_token" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "token" varchar(4096) NOT NULL, "platform" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "app_version" varchar(32) NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" datetime NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "user_id" char(32) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "unique_device_token_per_org" UNIQUE ("org_id", "token") );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "django_admin_log" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "object_id" text NULL, "object_repr" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "action_flag" smallint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("action_flag" >= 0), "change_message" text NOT NULL, "content_type_id" integer NULL, "user_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "action_time" datetime NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "django_content_type" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "app_label" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "model" varchar(100) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "django_migrations" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "app" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "applied" datetime NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "django_ses_blacklistedemail" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "email" varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "django_ses_sesstat" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "date" date NOT NULL UNIQUE, "delivery_attempts" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("delivery_attempts" >= 0), "bounces" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("bounces" >= 0), "complaints" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("complaints" >= 0), "rejects" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("rejects" >= 0) );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "django_session" ( "session_key" varchar(40) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "session_data" text NOT NULL, "expire_date" datetime NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title" text NULL, "document_file" varchar(5000) NOT NULL, "status" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document_shared_to" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "document_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "profile_id" char(32) NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document_teams" ( "id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "document_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "teams_id" char(32) NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "emailLogs" ( "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "is_sent" bool NOT NULL, "contact_id" char(32) NULL, "created_by_id" char(32) NULL, "email_id" char(32) NULL, "org_id" char(32) NOT NULL, "updated_by_id" char(32) NULL );
